issues.description: React hydration mismatch in apps/web/app/design/step-3/page.tsx causing full root hydration failure. Server renders '%s' but client renders 'Which room are we designing?' / 'Style Quiz'. This cascades to hydration errors across the entire app including the auth page.
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/design/step-3/page.tsx, a dynamic value (likely from useState or Math.random or Date or browser-only API) is used to render heading text differently on server vs client. The server interpolates a format string '%s' while the client renders actual text, suggesting a string formatting or i18n function is being called differently in SSR vs CSR context.
